Question: The taxi fare in Gotham City is \(\$2.40\) for the first \(\dfrac{1}{2}\) mile and additional mileage charged at the rate \(\$0.20\) for each additional \(0.1\) mile. You plan to give the driver a \(\$2\) tip. How many miles can you ride for \(\$10\)?
